title: 第一卷 第9章 天隐玉第一卷 第10章 万宝阁
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
“老师，我懂！”
顾天凡重重握紧双拳，眼神变得无比坚定。
“族长哥哥在为了家族的未来而谋划，而奋斗，我作为顾家子弟，更不能拖后腿！”
“王嫣然三日后来退婚，这不仅是我的耻辱，更是整个顾家的耻辱！”
“我必须在三日之内，突破凝气境！”
“届时，我要让她，让王家看看，我顾家儿郎，不是任人揉捏的软柿子！”
少年眼中燃烧着熊熊的火焰，三年来所受的嘲讽与白眼，此刻尽数化为最强大的动力。
“好！
有志气！”
木老赞许道。
“既然如此，事不宜迟，我们这就开始！”
“凝气境的关键在于压缩丹田气旋，使之由虚化实，灵力凝练如汞。”
“你根基已无比扎实，又有老夫从旁护法，三日时间，足够了！”
“现在，屏气凝神，运转《焚天诀》，引导灵力，冲击瓶颈！”
“是！
老师！”
顾天凡不再犹豫，立刻盘膝坐回青石之上，摒弃一切杂念，全力运转功法《焚天诀》。
刹那间，他周身灵气涌动，隐隐有炽热之意散发而出。
……
顾天阳离开顾天凡的小院后，准备出去一趟。

“系统，打开家族商城。”
【叮！
家族商城已开启！
光幕瞬间浮现在他的意识之中，琳琅满目的商品。
从体质、功法、武技到奇珍异宝、天材地宝，应有尽有。
顾天阳没有去看那些动辄需要数十万、上百万族运点的顶级宝物。
而是直接在搜索栏中输入了易容二字。
光幕瞬间刷新，一系列能够改变容貌的物品出现在眼前。
玄级上品——幻颜纱：消耗100族运点，可改变容貌，凝气境修士难以看破，灵海境可窥破端倪。
地级极品——千面玉：消耗300族运点，可随心变换容貌，灵海境修士无法看破。
天级极品——天隐玉：消耗500族运点，佩戴后可自由切换容貌，完美模拟气息，除非修为高出宿主三个大境界。
顾天阳的目光直接落在了最后的天隐玉上。
“就它吧！”
content_en:
"Teacher, I understand!"
Gu Tianfan clenched his fists tightly and his eyes became extremely firm.
"Brother, the patriarch, is planning and fighting for the future of the family. As a descendant of the Gu family, I cannot hold back!"
"Wang Yanran broke off the engagement three days later. This is not only a shame for me, but also a shame for the entire Gu family!"
"I must break through the Qi Condensation Realm within three days!"
"At that time, I will show her and the Wang family that I, the son of the Gu family, am not a soft persimmon that can be manipulated by others!"
There was a blazing fire in the young man's eyes, and all the ridicule and supercilious looks he had received in the past three years turned into the most powerful motivation at this moment.
"Okay!
Be ambitious! "
Mu Lao praised.
"In that case, without further ado, let's get started!"
"The key to the Qi Condensation state is to compress the cyclone in the Dantian, turning it from virtual to solid, and the spiritual power is condensed like mercury."
"Your foundation is extremely solid, and I have you protecting me. Three days is enough!"
"Now, hold your breath and concentrate, run the "Burning Heaven Technique", guide your spiritual power, and hit the bottleneck!"
"Yes!
Teacher! "
Gu Tianfan no longer hesitated and immediately sat cross-legged on the bluestone, abandoning all distracting thoughts and running the "Burning Heaven Technique" with all his strength.
In an instant, spiritual energy surged around him, with a faint glow emanating from it.
…
After Gu Tianyang left Gu Tianfan's courtyard, he was ready to go out.
"System, open the family mall."
[Ding!
The family mall has been opened!
A curtain of light instantly appeared in his consciousness, a dazzling array of products.
From physiques, exercises, and martial arts to rare treasures, heavenly materials, and earthly treasures, everything is available.
Gu Tianyang did not look at those top-level treasures that often require hundreds of thousands or millions of clan luck points.
Instead, he directly entered the word "disguise" into the search bar.
The light screen refreshed instantly, and a series of items that could change the appearance appeared in front of him.
Mysterious level top grade - Huanyan gauze: It consumes 100 clan luck points to change the appearance. It is difficult for monks in the Qi Condensation realm to see through it, but it can be seen through in the Spirit Sea realm.
The best earth-level product - Thousand-faced Jade: It consumes 300 clan luck points and can change its appearance at will. Monks in the spiritual sea realm cannot see through it.
The best heaven-level jade - Tianyin Jade: It consumes 500 clan luck points. After wearing it, you can freely switch the appearance and perfectly simulate the aura, unless the cultivation level is three realms higher than the host.
Gu Tianyang's eyes fell directly on the last Tianyin Jade.
"That's it!"
